[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The bootstrap EC2 instance can start before the Elasticsearch role's inline discovery policy is attached. Order instance creation after the policy so its bootstrap code has the required EC2 describe permissions.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The bootstrap EC2 instance uses the Elasticsearch discovery role and can start its bootstrap process before the discovery policy is attached. Add an explicit dependency so the instance is created after the policy is provisioned.

[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The master Auto Scaling Group can launch instances before the Elasticsearch role's inline discovery policy is attached. Make the group wait for the policy before launching its members.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Elasticsearch discovery inline policy grants permissions needed by the launched Elasticsearch instances, but this ASG can launch instances before that policy is attached. Add an explicit dependency so master nodes start only after the policy is provisioned.

[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The data Auto Scaling Group can launch instances before the Elasticsearch role's inline discovery policy is attached. Make the group wait for the policy before launching its members.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Elasticsearch discovery inline policy grants permissions needed by data-node instances, but this ASG can launch instances before that policy is attached. Add an explicit dependency so data nodes start only after the policy is provisioned.

[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The single-node Auto Scaling Group can launch its instance before the Elasticsearch role's inline discovery policy is attached. Make the group wait for the policy before launching its member.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Elasticsearch discovery inline policy grants permissions needed by the single-node Elasticsearch instance, but this ASG can launch it before the policy is attached. Add an explicit dependency so the node starts only after the policy is provisioned.

[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The bootstrap instance receives the master Auto Scaling Group name and needs the conditional ASG-discovery permissions available before bootstrapping. Order the instance after this policy attachment.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The bootstrap user data is given the master Auto Scaling Group name, and the conditional ASG-discovery policy is intended to authorize that discovery; the bootstrap instance can nevertheless start before the policy is attached. Add an explicit dependency so bootstrap starts after the policy is provisioned.

[merged-glm-5.3-flash-atleast2of3]
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
aws_autoscaling_group.data_nodes launches Elasticsearch data nodes that must discover and join masters provided by aws_autoscaling_group.master_nodes (ASG-based discovery via the instance role); the master ASG must exist first, but no dependency expresses this ordering.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
The data-node autoscaling group must be created after the master-node autoscaling group so that data nodes do not start before the master nodes have formed the Elasticsearch cluster. The source declares depends_on = ["aws_autoscaling_group.master_nodes"] on aws_autoscaling_group.data_nodes, but the graph records no dependency on the master ASG (no implicit path exists either), so the intended ordering is not enforced.

[merged-glm-5.3-flash-atleast2of3]
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
null_resource.cluster_bootstrap_state writes the cluster bootstrap marker file with a local-exec provisioner; it must run only after aws_instance.bootstrap_node (which performs the one-time cluster bootstrap) has been created, otherwise the state marker is recorded before bootstrap completes. The null resource currently has no dependency on it.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
null_resource.cluster_bootstrap_state writes the cluster_bootstrap_state file ("1" on create, "0" on destroy) that gates whether the bootstrap node is created, so it must only run after aws_instance.bootstrap_node has been created. The source declares depends_on = ["aws_instance.bootstrap_node"], but no dependency is captured in the graph; without it the state file could be written before the bootstrap node exists, breaking the bootstrap-once logic on subsequent applies.
